name: Sleep With Your Eyes Open (Ex)
body:
Benefit(s): The ninja has trained herself to remain alert to danger at all times and in all circumstances. She does not take a penalty to Perception checks when asleep, and is not considered helpless when naturally asleep. A ninja with this trick that suffers magic sleep is helpless.

Ultimate Options: Power of the Ninja © 2011, Rogue Genius Games, LLC; Author: Owen K.C. Stephens.
